It doesn't quite go far enough, though. We should also ask ourselves, "why would the FBI would want to sow fear?" Doing so leads to the inevitable conclusion that it provides a justification for taking away individual liberties and strengthening an increasingly powerful police state. The US government learned a dangerous lesson after 9/11: a populace in fear is most willing to give up liberty for security. Unfortunately, it has employed that lesson many times since with policies like the USA PATRIOT Act and widespread NSA surveillance.

We shouldn't be surprised when our government votes to give itself more power, but we must remember to be mindful of fear-induced complacency lest we allow it to go completely unchecked.
